authority: Jared active Goal: Phase 1 screen; captured-usage allowance and processing-time limit
spend_rule: captured priced usage + live allowances + retained terminal unresolved charges must satisfy job/run/campaign and diagnostic-subcap gates before further dispatch
unknown_usage: retain unknown and reservation; never substitute zero
rate_limit_rule: fresh typed account state before every launch; hold on any warning, reached limit, spend-control warning, or unavailable required state; do not retry a warning
repeats: two predeclared replicates of A/B/C per case; preserve every failure, never choose best-of retry
stop_rule: stop cleanly at any applicable limit; keep incremental outputs and all failed attempts with reasons; report missing comparisons without trimming repeats
pricing_basis: Captured native tokens valued under the frozen historical experimental pricing convention in baseline/protocol/cost_watch.py; API-equivalent policy metric, not a verified current public tariff, cash invoice, or subscription-credit conversion.
qualification_state: preparation; user spend authority recorded, no provider launched
processing_time_definition: Union of active run wall intervals, including controller and tool work; account warning terminalizes active run and holds remaining schedule. Development/evaluation timing reported separately.
